comment.body:
<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"520cd1febab68ed266da0eee8b03bef97a52ac0227ba1d5e77ba448c28f348e9"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

Fallback — The page refused to load in the run browser:⁠ main document returned HTTP 403

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — Reported defect is a behavioral annoyance on jkanime.net (a click opens an unrelated site in a new tab), but every browser attempt to reach the site returned an HTTP 403 "Just a moment..." interstitial, so the click could not be rehearsed and no candidate could be validated; the best candidate is carried for human review.

## Candidate for review

`jkanime.net#%#//scriptlet('prevent-window-open')`

BaseFilter/sections/general_extensions.txt

Not verified: Browser access to the reported page was exhausted before any evidence could be collected:⁠ all three navigation attempts (control session without extension on desktop, prepared AdGuard extension v5.5.2.3 with filters 2/3/19 on desktop, and the same prepared session on a materially different mobile profile) returned HTTP 403 with the title 'Just a moment...' and an interstitial URL, and the third returned technical_attempt_budget_exhausted. No DOM, network inventory or click rehearsal was obtainable, so the reported click-to-popup symptom could neither be reproduced nor shown absent, apply_rule never ran and no visual review or page-integrity verdict exists for this candidate. Note also that jkanime.net is already listed in the shared BaseFilter/sections/general_extensions.txt rule for scriptlet("abort-on-property-read", "popjs"), which a maintainer should check first.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/44964840031

<sub>Automated analysis against filters at `5a5cbd6`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.</sub>

comment.body:
<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"69bba2e30df4dddc4bd3a5488f6f479172eb33b42f28ae59dfa2358ac2f0f593"} -->
The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Not reproduced — The left-rail SkinRave banners reported on steamcommunity.com/market are not served by the page:⁠ it loaded fine in both an unfiltered Chromium session and the reporter's exact filter configuration, with all 883 requests going to Steam/Fastly hosts, no "Remove ads" text, and the site's own centred 940px market layout containing no ad rail. The reporter's screenshot also shows Steam Inventory Helper's own "SIH Features"/"SIH Games" items injected into Steam's header, so the banners most likely come from an extension in the reporter's browser rather than from the site (hypothesis, not proven).

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Policy rationale

The run instruction's closing rules do not cover this report:⁠ it is a plain ads report, not a first-party-ad case, a paywall, a German anti-adblock wall, another anti-adblock wall, or a scam/phishing page, so no policy rule blocks rule generation. Rule generation is allowed; the closure rests on the observed absence of the reported defect, not on a policy block.

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/44969521690
